repeat.text: Once this perk has been taken, it cannot be taken again by any other player characters.

effects.text: On pick, you and each other PC immediately gain 1000 XP.
Pick-time choice: distribute 3 points (lost hand or foot) or 5 points (lost arm or leg) among ability scores, per missing limb. Foot or leg loss no longer limits movement to 20 feet.
You can "see" any target within 5 x your Perception score feet.
Drawing a lever action rifle, cowboy repeater or revolver costs 1 AP. Attacks that hit a surprised creature with those weapons critically hit.
+2 to attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons per rank; an extra +2 per rank on targeted attack rolls to the head with ranged weapons.
+2 to attack and damage rolls with unarmed or melee weapons per rank.
4 skill points per grant instead of 3, and retroactive points as if INT were 5. The modifier adds 1 per grant reached on top of the base 3 (requires INT 4 or lower).
Damage rolled against insects ignores their DT.
Per rank: +1 DT against damage to HP from faction-affiliated creatures, and +1 damage to faction-affiliated creatures.
+3 per rank to unarmed or melee attack rolls against abominations.
+3 per rank to damage from attack rolls against humanoids with no faction affiliation.
Whenever the GM awards XP, you and each other PC gain an additional 20% bonus.
Spend 6 AP for a heavy unarmed attack: an unarmed attack with damage increased by 2d4. You can still become heavily encumbered.
No disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons whose Strength requirement you don't meet. Ignore the negative effects of the first two levels of decay on all weapons.
+2 to damage rolls from melee weapon attacks. A targeted bladed melee attack to an arm or leg that deals more than double the creature's level in HP damage severs the limb.

+3 to damage rolls from unarmed attacks that damage a target's stamina points. A targeted unarmed attack to the head dealing more than the creature's level in HP damage makes it dazed for 8 - its Endurance score rounds (minimum 1).
The distance you can throw an object or creature is doubled.
You don't become slowed when carrying heavy objects.
Spend 4 AP to frighten a creature within 30 feet. You can't frighten a creature you have already frightened.
Long jumps clear an additional 10 feet and high jumps an additional 3 feet. Impact damage from falls is halved.

After spending AP to move at least 15 feet in a straight line, your next unarmed or melee weapon attack has advantage. If it hits and damages HP, the target falls prone or is knocked back 5 x your Strength modifier feet.
Advantage on Strength or ability checks to resist being grappled, restrained or knocked prone, or flip a Karma Cap to automatically succeed.
The first time you deal damage to a creature's HP with an unarmed or melee weapon attack, it becomes dazed for 2 rounds.
Unarmed and melee weapon damage reduces the target's DT by your Strength modifier (minimum DT 0).

Hitting a single target with at least three melee attacks in a turn gives it 2 levels of fatigue. At 4 levels of fatigue this way it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn, and can't be paralyzed this way again until you roll combat sequence.
Spend 4 AP to become Rooted (3 AP to end it). While Rooted: +5 DT, +2 damage on unarmed and melee weapon attacks, and moving 5 feet costs 2 AP.
Damage from unarmed and melee weapon attacks against a creature's HP ignores its DT.
Attacks with an improvised weapon increase damage by 1 die rank and decrease critical hit chance by 1.

Use a creature as an improvised weapon (grapple check if unwilling): 6 AP, Melee Weapons skill, crit 20 (x2), impact damage 3d6 small / 4d6 medium / 5d6 large (not huge or larger). Throw them 2 x your Strength score feet; a creature thrown into another and dealing impact damage to HP makes both fall prone. The used creature takes half the impact damage dealt to HP.
Gain 1 AP whenever you spend AP to make an unarmed or melee weapon attack. Critical hit chance with all unarmed and melee weapons decreases by 1.
Ranged weapon attacks: spend 1 extra AP to add 1 to the attack roll, up to 3 extra AP (+3 total).
No disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks or skill checks from low-light conditions. Second rank: night vision out to 100 feet.

After staying within a 20 foot radius for at least 10 minutes, passive sense gains a bonus (rulebook text says your Perception score, but its parenthetical gives 12 + double your Perception modifier, i.e. a bonus equal to modPER; see ERRATA E17).
Spend 3 AP and examine a lock or computer within 5 feet to learn its Breach DC. On a failed Breach check, flip a Karma Cap to succeed instead.
Energy weapon damage rolls get one additional damage die per rank. On a critical hit with an energy weapon, make one extra attack (max one per turn) or double the critical damage.
When you roll Combat Sequence, you and creatures within 30 feet gain a bonus equal to your Perception modifier. Affects one other creature, plus one more per additional rank.
Stimpak, first aid kit or doctor's bag used on another creature heals an additional 2 HP per rank, or flip a Karma Cap to heal double.
Applies to each player character's carry load (+10 per rank). Items you carry with a load less than 3 count as load 1.
Area of effect of your attacks is increased by half; a second rank doubles the area.
Thrown, unplaced explosives: exclude a 5 foot radius from the effect, or reduce the area of effect radius by up to 5 feet.
Energy weapon attacks can target up to three creatures in a line; a second rank raises it to six.
Damage dealt with an explosive is increased by one additional die per rank.
Explosive damage to your stamina points is halved.
When a laser, plasma or electricity weapon attack brings a creature to 0 HP, it can explode: each creature within 10 feet takes damage equal to the amount you dealt.

Two-handed ranged weapon attacks: spend 1 extra AP to add 2 to the attack roll, up to 3 extra AP (+6 total). A targeted head attack with a scoped rifle critically hits and kills a target that can't live without its head and has no power armor helmet.
Throwing an explosive costs 1 less AP (minimum 3). On a natural 20 on the Explosives check, the explosive detonates at the end of your turn and deals extra damage equal to double the damage dice.
When another creature rests 1 hour, heal half of its total HP with a first aid kit, stimpak or doctor's bag; after 4 hours of rest, heal all of it. Second rank: heal all HP after 1 hour.
When you roll Combat Sequence, swap the rolls of any number of willing creatures. Second rank: up to three additional creatures, which need not be willing.
Cooked food you make always has the filling property, and bland food becomes tasty. Creatures eating it gain temporary stamina points equal to their level.
Each other player character's maximum hit points increase by 1 per rank.
Whenever you become frightened, you can always choose to be frightened (fight).
Moving through water: 1 AP moves you 10 feet instead of 5 (ERRATA E19). Drinking dirty water gives no irradiated levels.
Sprinting moves you 80 feet in a line instead of 50.

Once per day when you start traveling, roll Survival DC 12 (+2 for difficult terrain, a route over 3 days, or unfamiliar territory); on success you and your travel companions move 2 miles per hour faster. You also have advantage on encounter rolls.

Against a creature whose type and subtype you have rolled combat sequence with: spend 3 AP to learn its HP, SP, AP, AC or DT, or 6 AP to learn one attack or weakness. Each additional rank (max 3) lets you learn one more statistic, action or weakness.
While dying, movement costs no extra AP and you gain 1 additional AP at the start of your turn (2 additional in total at the second rank; ERRATA E18).
While traveling, you and each PC can travel an additional hour before gaining a level of exhaustion. You regain all stamina points after resting 1 hour instead of 8.
You ignore the negative effects of the first three levels of exhaustion.

After resting at least 1 hour in direct sunlight, gain temporary stamina points equal to your level. When rolling damage, you can lose any number of those temporary stamina points to add that much damage.
After resting outside for at least 1 hour, gain temporary HP and SP equal to your level for 8 hours. Second rank: other creatures of your choice resting with you gain the same bonus.
The first time each turn you fall to 0 HP, you can flip a Karma Cap to heal HP equal to your healing rate.
Spend 3 AP to heal SP or HP equal to your healing rate (once until you rest 6 hours). Whenever you heal hit points, you gain a bonus equal to your Endurance modifier.
Pick-time/use-time choice: spend 3 AP to gain resistance to three damage types of your choice for 3 rounds; then unusable until you rest 1 hour or roll combat sequence.
When you roll combat sequence, you and creatures of your choice gain temporary HP equal to your Endurance modifier. Spend 3 AP on a dying creature within 5 feet to give it one successful death save.
Spend 3 AP to activate: heal HP equal to your healing rate at the start of each of your turns for 6 rounds. Unusable again until you rest 1 hour or roll combat sequence.
